author: Avetetsuya Studios
title: Hiring Freelance Artists for Character Design, Illustration, Backgrounds
content:
HIRING LOOKING FOR FREELANCE ARTISTS
Avetetsuya Studios saat ini membuka kesempatan bagi freelance artist untuk berkolaborasi dalam berbagai proyek mendatang.
Kami mencari artist yang memiliki kemampuan dalam:
-Character Design & Illustration
-Character Sprites
-Background & Environment Art
-Webtoon / Comic Artwork
-Game & Digital Art Assets
-Ilustrasi dan visual development lainnya
Cara Melamar: kirimkan portofolio dan perkenalan singkat ke: avetetsuyastudios@gmail.com
Gunakan subject email: Freelance Artist Application – [Nama Anda]

author: Anonymous participant
title: Looking for artist for Ganondorf comfort art / yume
content:
Looking for artist (please READ)
I'm looking for artists that can do any of these two options:
— 1. Typical comfort art (in this case with Ganondorf), where viewer is in 1st sight and the character is looking directly at "camera" saying sweet things.
— 2. Pairs, yume.
I prefer the Wind Waker version of Ganondorf...
PAYING EXCLUSIVELY THROUGH PAYPAL. (or vgen, kofi, etc if it accepts paypal).
PUT YOUR TAT!!!!!! IF IT'S MORE THAN 2 WEEKS I'M JUST NOT INTERESTED.
